H,W=28,19
objs={
5:(5,[(0,8),(1,5),(1,6),(1,7),(2,5),(2,6),(2,7),(3,5),(3,6),(3,7),(4,4)]),
9:(4,[(0,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1),(3,1)]),
8:(11,[(0,c) for c in range(11,16)]+[(1,13),(2,13)]),
4:(17,[(0,4),(1,4),(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,4),(4,4)])
}
def make_grid(choices):
 g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
 for color,(r0,pts) in objs.items():
  top=choices[color]
  minr=min(r for r,c in pts); maxr=max(r for r,c in pts)
  dr=(-minr-r0) if top else (H-1-maxr-r0)
  for r,c in pts:g[r0+dr+r][c]=color
 return g
candidate=make_grid({5:False,9:False,8:False,4:True})
import json
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':candidate},separators=(',',':')))
